parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for reporting this—sorry for the disruption to your operations team. We understand that after the last release the analytics dashboard now takes about 30–45 seconds to load (previously under 5 seconds), which is slowing daily planning for 25 users.

We’re escalating this to our engineering team for investigation as a likely performance regression tied to the recent release. To help us narrow it down quickly, could you share a few details?
1) The release version number (or the release date/time) after which this started
2) Whether the delay is consistent for all affected users or intermittent
3) Where the time is spent (e.g., loading the dashboard page, data retrieval, charts rendering). If you can, please also note any browser console/network errors or screenshots of the slow-loading state
4) Browser and version(s) used by your operations team
5) Whether this happens for all regions/users or only specific ones

Once we have these, we can correlate the timing with the release changes and identify which component/endpoints are contributing to the added latency.
promised_actions: Escalate the issue to our engineering team for investigation
Review the provided details to help narrow down where the added latency is occurring
safety_notes: We cannot confirm root cause or recovery timeline yet; response requests minimal clarification needed for troubleshooting.
